1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，this phrase redundantly combines a time period with another “time of” expression. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 城市有才两个学校：城市才有两个学校，才 must come before the verb 有 when it limits the number that exists. [rule: none]
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 一个男孩子跟他的妈妈住在中国。他叫孟子：一个叫孟子的男孩子跟他的妈妈住在中国，at first mention, introduce the main character with both a name and a noun phrase rather than naming him only in the next sentence. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 他很喜欢他的城市：他很喜欢自己的城市，when the possessor is the same person as the subject, use 自己的 to make that relationship clear. [teacher rule: ziji_possessor]

items.reason: 古代 already denotes a time period, so 古代的时候 is redundantly formed under the teacher's rule.
The original has an incorrect 才 placement, but the teacher's required expression is 只有 rather than 才有.
Introducing him as 一个男孩子 and naming him in the immediately following sentence is already clear and acceptable.
Because the city belongs to the subject 他, the teacher's 自己的 rule calls for 自己的城市 to make the possessor clear.
